tests.description: Verifies crystal2 does not move vertically at scene start or while the camera scrolls.
tests.name: Crystal2 stays in place
source: const snap = () => { const o = harness.getObjects('crystal2'); return o.map(c => ({x: Math.round(c.x), y: Math.round(c.y), w: c.width, h: c.height, anim: c.animation})); };
harness.assert(first.y === last.y, 'crystal2 Y unchanged over 3s (start y=' + first.y + ', end y=' + last.y + ')');
// also hold Right to scroll camera like real play
harness.assert(after.y === first.y, 'crystal2 Y unchanged after camera scroll');
